نتكاثر (form VI)
# نَتَكَاثَرُ (natakāṯaru) /na.ta.kaː.θa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَاثَرَ (takāṯara)
# نَتَكَاثَرَ (natakāṯara) /na.ta.kaː.θa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَاثَرَ (takāṯara)
# نَتَكَاثَرْ (natakāṯar) /na.ta.kaː.θar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَاثَرَ (takāṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
